# CornfedBucks

> Practical, working-hunter content for Midwest whitetail hunters on ag-land — straight-wall cartridge (SWC) regulations, gear, and row-crop tactics for Ohio, Michigan, Indiana, Iowa, Illinois, Minnesota, and Wisconsin.

## Core guides
- Straight-Wall Cartridge State Regulations: https://cornfedbucks.com/blog/straight-wall-cartridge-state-regulations
- The Ultimate Guide to Straight-Wall Cartridge Hunting: https://cornfedbucks.com/blog/ultimate-guide-straight-wall-cartridge-hunting
- 2026 Deer Season Regulations, 7-State Roundup: https://cornfedbucks.com/blog/2026-deer-season-regulations-seven-state-roundup
- Deer Hunting License Guide: 7-State Corn Belt Edition: https://cornfedbucks.com/blog/deer-hunting-license-guide-seven-state
- Trail Camera Strategy for Pressured Row-Crop Ground: https://cornfedbucks.com/blog/trail-camera-cell-cam-strategy
- Slug Shotgun vs. Straight-Wall Rifle for Youth Hunters: https://cornfedbucks.com/blog/slug-shotgun-vs-straight-wall-rifle-youth
- Youth Deer Hunting Checklist: A Parent's Prep Guide: https://cornfedbucks.com/blog/youth-deer-hunting-checklist
- FireStick & NitroFire Muzzleloader Legality by State: https://cornfedbucks.com/blog/firestick-nitrofire-muzzleloader-legality-2026
- Ballistics Comparison Tool (trajectory & energy across 15 cartridges): https://cornfedbucks.com/ballistics-comparison

Evergreen, refreshed each year when state DNRs publish new dates — not dated field notes.
- Ohio Deer Season Dates: https://cornfedbucks.com/ohio-deer-season-dates

- Indiana Deer Season Dates: https://cornfedbucks.com/indiana-deer-season-dates
- Iowa Deer Season Dates: https://cornfedbucks.com/iowa-deer-season-dates
- Illinois Deer Season Dates: https://cornfedbucks.com/illinois-deer-season-dates
- Minnesota Deer Season Dates: https://cornfedbucks.com/minnesota-deer-season-dates
- Wisconsin Deer Season Dates: https://cornfedbucks.com/wisconsin-deer-season-dates

## About
Written by Nick, a working hunter covering ag-lease country. Newsletter: The Monday Morning Report.
